description:
Variation
of Conditions 2 (Plans) and 45 (Floor Space) of planning permission reference
212178, granted 27/10/2021; to allow for amendments to the approved
scheme, including revisions to the fire strategy and layouts within Blocks A
and B to accommodate additional stair cores and lifts, the provision of additional
residential units and additional heights within Blocks A and B, and a revised
landscaping scheme, with associated changes to cycle parking and vehicle
parking, play space, refuse and plant rooms. 

[For information only: the additions are: 46 residential units; one floor above Blocks A3 & B3; two storeys above Block B4 and four storeys above Block B5]. [Explanation:
This is an application made under s73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990
(as amended)
for the variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) and Condition 45 (floor
space), attached to s73
planning  permission reference 212178 granted 27/10/2021 which varied conditions  attached to planning
permission reference 193694 granted 23/12/2020, as amended by Non-Material
Amendment applications reference 230991  granted on 31/05/2023, and 210387
granted 10/03/2021.]
